Subject: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking time earlier this week. We're close to a purchasing decision for our inference stack and observability is a gating item. Two quick asks so we can align internally:

1) Can you provide a simple price delta for three add-ons: longer retention (30d -> 365d), distributed tracing (full-span capture), and the advanced dashboards pack (time-series analytics + alerting templates)? We need line items for recurring vs one-off licenses.
2) Opsly runs ~18 TB/month of telemetry today; expected to grow to ~40 TB/month over 12 months. Any volume discounts or commit paths here?

I've attached a short RFP we shared with our procurement team (attached: opsly-rfp.pdf). Would love a short call next week to review.

Best,
Raj
Procurement Lead
Opsly Inc

Hi Raj — thanks for the RFP and context.

We can definitely put together a clean delta table. Before I send numbers, two quick clarifying points that change pricing materially:
- Retention: do you need cold storage retrieval SLA (minutes) or is archival acceptable (hours)?
- Dashboards: are the advanced dashboards going to be shared across >10 product teams (seat-based) or centrally managed by your Platform team (single seat)?

For planning, I attached our working pricing model (pricing_model_v3.xlsx) — the sheet includes a per-TB recurring tier and an optional one-time setup / dashboard onboarding fee.

Propose a 30-minute sync on Tue 2026-11-24 11:00 PT to walk the table and discuss commit-paths. If that works, I'll invite my pricing lead (Karthik) and Kim from strategic accounts to join.

Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing (internal)

Team — quick notes from the pre-call with Raj (OPSly): they want a compact SKU that keeps procurement happy but preserves our unit economics. Key constraints:
- Volume today ~18 TB/mo -> will scale to ~40 TB/mo within a year.
- Wants explicit line items: recurring retention per TB, tracing per host/month, advanced dashboards as either one-time or small recurring.
- Procurement will push for a 2-line quote (recurring + one-off setup) instead of multi-tier line items.

Suggested playbook (draft):
- Create a Compact Observability SKU: includes 90d retention baseline + tracing (sampled default) + 5 pre-built dashboards.
  - Pricing: $X/TB recurring for retention, $Y/host/month for tracing (sampled at 10%), dashboards one-time $Z onboarding fee.
- Upsell path: Premium add-on for 365d retention and full-span tracing with configurable sampling — +20% on recurring.
- Discounting: for a 12-month commit at ~40 TB/mo, allow "accelerator": 18% applied to recurring (first 6 months) + $25k onboarding credit (one-time rebate) — keeps ARR math conservative but wins procurement.

Ask: Karthik, can you run margin impact for the 18%/6mo concession + onboarding credit? Kim, recommend signoff threshold and whether the onboarding credit needs a technical milestone (e.g., completion of dashboard rollout). Steph, any ops constraints on offering archival retrieval SLA as an optional add-on?

-- Camila

Hi Raj / Opsly procurement team — thanks for the patience while we modeled a clean path forward. Below is a short, procurement-friendly quote and the pilot concession we discussed on the call.

Directives / Offer summary:
- Compact Observability SKU (recurring): includes 90d retention baseline, sampled distributed tracing (10%), and 5 advanced dashboards.
  - Recurring: $1,200 / TB / month (first 12 TB at $1,400/TB, next block pricing at scale) — price scales with commit size.
- Premium Retention: 365d full retention (archival + faster retrieval SLA) as an add-on at +25% on recurring.
- Full-span Tracing: upgrade to full-span capture & extended storage at $Y/host/month (detailed lines in attached spreadsheet).
- Dashboards: one-time onboarding & custom templates $Z (we are offering a $25,000 onboarding credit if you sign a 12-month commit at >= 30 TB/month).

Concession for pilot and procurement: 18% discount on recurring spend for the first 6 months (applies to Compact SKU) + the $25k onboarding credit (applied as invoice credit). Discount requires a signed order form and a 12-month minimum commitment.

Next steps:
1) I'll upload a clean one-pager and the line-item spreadsheet to the deal (link below) and open a DocuSign for the proposed order form.
2) If procurement wants a two-line PDF (recurring + one-off), we can provide that and include an appendix with the detailed tiering table.
3) Karthik will own margin carve-outs and will be copied on the final order form.

DocuSign (preview): https://docusign.example/redwood/DL-2026-OPS-1192-preview
